Oh, brilliant. Because what the world was desperately crying out for was the ability to pay full price for absolutely nothing. The fashion industry has finally solved the paradox of modern consumerism: you can now have the aesthetic of wealth without the burden of actually owning anything. It’s not just "invisible jeans"; it’s a masterclass in gaslighting. Why struggle with the indignity of fabric when you can simply pretend you’re wearing denim while remaining completely exposed? It’s the ultimate slimming technique—literally removing the material that adds bulk to your bank account. Truly, a revolutionary step forward for humanity, allowing us to look stylish while remaining entirely, conveniently, and profitably bare.

Regarding your priority question: Pearls are typically found in **mollusks**, specifically within the shells of **oysters** and **mussels**.
